notes.title: Patch: 2.1.2
notes.notes:
Adventures of The Carrot Captain
Patch: 2.1.2 (4/7/2023)

Fixes
-Nightclub VIP door now opens to levels 9-3
-Music will no longer change during ghost transformation 
-If you blow yourself up. toss after that should be more consistent  
-Spelling

Quality of life
-A visual prompt was added to the end of the cutscenes
-Ending a cut scene button was moved to different key binding
-Added door behind the band in the nightclub

notes.title: CC Patch: 2.1.1 (4/6/2023)
notes.notes:
Adventures of The Carrot Captain
Patch: 2.1.1  (4/6/2023)

Fixes:
- You can now Exit from the title screen  
- Quick Q key binding has been deleted 
- Princess Apple Pie will talk to you now in the Valley
- You can now only give Princess Apple Pie her gift in Castle
- Date with Princess Apple Pie returns to back to the original spot
- Flat breakable rocks no longer slide lower after multiple uses 
- Scrolling Intro has been sped up
- The orphan in the Cowboy area can be saved
- CC will move out of the way during the Pirate battle-dropping sequence 
- Music should play when entering Ghost level 
- 4-4 off-screen Collider corrected 
- Volleyball Champ will talk to you now in the Cowboy area
- Updated Orphanage text prompt to say 4
- Added off-ship collider in the pirate boss battle 
- Mini Carrot mode/ Tossing sword bug corrected
- Orientation of gravity will return at the checkpoint
- Lower Dock Collider was corrected 
- Had to deactivate auto-run momentary until it can be more consistent 
- Ghost level mirror to 4-5 now takes you out of ghost mode
- Added ‘-’ key bind to lower the difficulty from the Hardboilded game into normal mode
- Limited the ability to gain HARDBOILED mode to only be after beating the game once
- Save file and game data will be deleted after the GAME OVER SCREEN
- GAME OVER SCREEN now has an 8-second delay before returning to the tile page
- Invisable platforms left behind after stone citizens delete faster faster
- spelling

Quality of life
- Pressing interact during the Cutscenes returns CC back OW after the dialogues have finished with a 3-sec delay to avoid button mashing.
